_note: How each oracle property is read from a run. expr = named noise expression sampled through fh.py sample or the ep-s8-dump points probe; null = not built yet, so the property is skipped. rule: ge/gt/le/lt against threshold gives a boolean; bands maps value ranges to names; values maps rounded values to names; source 'tile' reads the real tile name from a probe.

region.hard: a key in a place's region_hard never flips: it is not listed whatever its margin
region.names: config.lua regions.names: destroyed_sd for 'destroyed', row.sd .. id .. suffix for 'row:<id>'

destroyed_zone.start_disc: a place within the world's start disc is exempt: the zone is 0 there (T7)
destroyed_zone.hot: Alien Biomes worlds with the zone on read temperature above 100 where the zone is positive
